# Support

AgentFramework is currently private, pre-release software at version `0.1.0`.

- Start with the [README](/README.md) and [installation guide](/INSTALL.md).
- Run `python3 scripts/af_dev.py --action check --execute` before reporting a defect.
- Search the [issue tracker](https://github.com/alexanderholman/AgentFramework/issues)
  before opening a new issue.
- Never put credentials, personal data, or vulnerability details in an ordinary issue.
  Follow the [security policy](/SECURITY.md) for security reports.

Support is best-effort while the framework is pre-release. Include a minimal
reproduction, Python and operating-system versions, the interface used, expected and
actual behaviour, and the exact failing command/output.
